title: Golden State College & Milan Institute
description: About Golden State College & Milan Institute Golden State College offers higher-education programs in areas such as accounting, information technology, social and behavioral science, and criminal justice. Milan Institute is a private career-training school founded in 1985, with vocational programs in fields including beauty, healthcare, massage, and business. Golden State College & Milan Institute fell victim to a cyberattack, resulting in the theft of more than 420 GB of confidential data. The stolen data includes documents containing correspondence with clients, financial information, personal data of employees and clients, as well as other important information about the company.
